verdict.rationale: Data region or residency selection is a fair question for a business communications SaaS that stores calls, texts, transcripts and contacts. Nothing in the evidence pack documents letting customers choose where their data is stored. Canadian virtual numbers are phone-number provisioning, and the us-west-2 S3 bucket only hosts the OpenAPI files, so neither is a customer residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
